verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Codex can inspect diffs and open pull requests when work is ready (codex-docs-5), integrates with GitHub for starting work and delegating tasks, and creates git checkpoints before/after tasks (codex-docs-40). However, there is no explicit documentation of Codex autonomously staging changes, writing commit messages, or creating branches as discrete named capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit docs on commit message generation, branch creation workflow, and independent/hands-on confirmation that PR opening works reliably in practice.
